reviews.comment: I would go to war with this man. By far the best prof ive had thus far

He's the goat. He explains concepts pretty clearly and makes the homework problems similar to the tests in terms of both difficulty and length. Because of this, homework does take some time to complete, but they're helpful. He also gives a good bit of extra credit.

Dr. Lan 100% the best thermo professor. He really cares about his students' success and is accessible for any questions. He provides practice exams that are similar to the real exam. His lectures are very helpful. I studied the least for this class and got an A on all exams. His lectures are straightforward and he is funny too. Test comes from HW.

Professor Lan is one reason why thermo was my favorite class this semester. His lectures are clear and straight to the point, he gives examples that are similar to homework and test questions, and he is very easy to talk to and happy to answer your questions. His tests averages are always higher than the other profs and his tests are reasonable.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Lan was wonderful. I felt like my thermo experience was easier than students with other professors, but then when I looked at their hw and tests they got back, our stuff was harder! It's just clear that I learned more because he's a good prof. His lectures are great, and he's really good at explaining concepts (his slides are good too)

Solid professor for thermodynamics in my opinion. His lecture slides do a pretty good job on highlighting on important things to remember and his practice exams are very helpful and resemble the real exams well. His exam averages are always higher than other sections. Gives short quizzes once a week that arent too bad either.
